        accuracy.append(accuracy_score(y_test,predict))

        f1.append(f1_score(y_test,predict,average='micro'))

    result.RecallScore=recall
    # The F1 score can be interpreted as a harmonic mean of the precision and recall,

    result.f1_Score=f1
